recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future work on the remaining core example that still uses valueset-systemName should be handled under FHIR-40710 or a new Terminology Infrastructure decision, not under FHIR-28119.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive seed issue asked to update valueset-systemName to align the VSD DrawnFromCodeSystem.DescriptiveName mapping with CodeSystem.title, but the final resolution required creating valueset-systemTitle with description "The human-readable name for the code system" and deprecating valueset-systemName.
initial_application: Core commit 9fca6ca36fefa544491b1efc7fdb1530333ed78b explicitly lists FHIR-28119 among R5 VSD Profile changes and added StructureDefinition/valueset-systemTitle while retaining valueset-systemName in the ValueSet core IG. Later core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the ValueSet extension StructureDefinitions from the R5 core source.
additional_context: FHIR-37923 removed the VSD Aligned Value Set Profile because newer shareable, computable, publishable, and executable ValueSet profiles superseded it. The current core ValueSet IG has no extension-definition entries, while the FHIR Extension Pack now maintains the remaining extension source: valueset-systemName is retired/deprecated with guidance to use the generic display extension, and valueset-systemTitle was removed under later Applied issue FHIR-40711.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Recreating valueset-systemTitle or changing valueset-systemName in core would reverse later applied decisions and edit artifacts that no longer live in the current core build.

related_jiras.note: Removed the VSD Aligned Value Set Profile after the VSD-driven FHIR-28119 application.
Deprecated valueset-systemName and directed users to the generic display extension.
Removed valueset-systemTitle because the display extension covers the same use case.
